item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS、A2P 人机市场与 OpenAI Agents SDK 更新
item.description:
标签: #智能体 #大模型 #基准测试 #AI研究

摘要: 本期AI简报聚焦三大产品动态：Google发布支持70余种语言且表现力更强的Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS，Humwork推出首个连接AI智能体与人类专家的A2P市场，以及OpenAI更新Agents SDK；此外还涉及科学发现智能体评估、AI基础设施Token成本优化与扩散语言模型强化学习稳定性等研究进展。

原标题: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS 🎙️, Agent-to-Person marketplace 🤝, OpenAI Agents SDK 🛠️

TLDR AI 2026-04-16

Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS 🎙️, Agent-to-Person marketplace 🤝, OpenAI Agents SDK 🛠️

Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS: the next generation of expressive AI speech (4 minute read)

Google's Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS enhances text-to-speech with improved expressivity and controllability, featuring a notable Elo score of 1,211 on the Artificial Analysis TTS leaderboard. The model supports over 70 languages and introduces audio tags for granular control of vocal style, allowing easy manipulation via natural language commands. All generated audio is watermarked with SynthID to ensure authentic content, preventing misinformation.

Google 的 Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS 通过提升表现力和可控性增强了文本转语音（text-to-speech）能力，在 Artificial Analysis TTS 排行榜上取得了 1,211 的显著 Elo 分数。该模型支持超过 70 种语言，并引入了音频标签以实现对声音风格的细粒度控制，可通过自然语言指令轻松操控。所有生成的音频均使用 SynthID 进行水印标记，以确保内容真实性并防止虚假信息传播。

Humwork A2P marketplace connects AI agents with experts (2 minute read)

Humwork launches the first Agent-to-Person (A2P) marketplace to connect AI agents with verified human experts when AI tools encounter challenges. The platform integrates with AI-centric tools like Claude Code and Replit, allowing handoffs to occur in under 30 seconds with full session context shared securely. With more than 1,000 experts available globally, Humwork boasts an 87% resolution rate and is backed by Y Combinator's P26 batch.

Humwork 推出了首个 Agent-to-Person (A2P) 市场，在 AI 工具遇到挑战时将 AI 智能体与经过验证的人类专家连接起来。该平台与 Claude Code 和 Replit 等以 AI 为中心的工具集成，可在 30 秒内完成交接（handoffs），并安全地共享完整的会话上下文。Humwork 在全球拥有超过 1,000 名专家，解决率达到 87%，并获得了 Y Combinator P26 批次的投资支持。

OpenAI's Updated Agents SDK (4 minute read)

OpenAI introduced updates to its Agents SDK, adding a model-native harness for cross-file and tool workflows along with sandboxed execution for safer task handling.

OpenAI 发布了其 Agents SDK 的更新，新增了用于跨文件和工具工作流的模型原生（model-native）执行框架，以及用于更安全任务处理的沙盒化执行环境。

Evaluating agents for scientific discovery (7 minute read)

Many teams are claiming extraordinary things about their agents. The evidence behind these claims is usually disappointing. ScienceWorld and DiscoveryWorld are benchmarks developed to test whether AI agents can actually do science. ScienceWorld asks whether agents can 're-make' classic scientific discoveries at roughly an elementary school level, while DiscoveryWorld tests open-ended discovery at a college or PhD level. These benchmarks, open and freely available, help test what science agents are actually capable of.

许多团队都在对其智能体做出非凡的宣传，但这些说法背后的证据往往令人失望。ScienceWorld 和 DiscoveryWorld 是为测试 AI 智能体是否真正能够从事科学研究而开发的基准（benchmark）。ScienceWorld 考察智能体能否在相当于小学水平的层次上“复现”经典科学发现，而 DiscoveryWorld 则在大学或博士水平上测试开放式发现能力。这些开放且免费的基准有助于测试科学智能体的实际能力。

Rethinking AI TCO: Why Cost per Token Is the Only Metric That Matters (6 minute read)

Cost per token is crucial for AI infrastructure TCO assessment due to its focus on delivered intelligence, integrating hardware, software, and utilization efficiencies. Unlike traditional metrics like compute cost or FLOPS per dollar, cost per token highlights real-world performance, enabling profitable AI scaling. Evidence from NVIDIA shows its Blackwell platform drastically reduces cost per token compared to Hopper, offering significant business value.

每 token 成本（Cost per token） 对于 AI 基础设施的 TCO（总拥有成本） 评估至关重要，因为它聚焦于实际交付的智能，并综合了硬件、软件和利用率效率。与计算成本或每美元 FLOPS 等传统指标不同，每 token 成本突显了真实世界性能，使 AI 能够盈利地扩展。NVIDIA 的数据显示，其 Blackwell 平台相比 Hopper 大幅降低了每 token 成本，带来了显著的商业价值。

Evaluating Agent Reasoning (28 minute read)

IBM Research uses an executable benchmark with thousands of APIs and documents to test multi-step agent reasoning and tool use, revealing consistent performance gaps and common failure modes.

IBM Research 使用一个包含数千个 API 和文档的可执行基准来测试多步智能体推理（multi-step agent reasoning）和工具使用，揭示了持续存在的性能差距和常见的失败模式。

Why do dLLMs tend to collapse in RL (3 minute read)

Diffusion Language Models (dLLMs) experience training collapse during Reinforcement Learning because their log-likelihood must be estimated using high-variance Monte Carlo sampling, which creates noisy importance ratios. These noisy ratios induce gradient spikes that push policy drift in a positive feedback loop, a problem that traditional AR methods like conditional clipping fail to solve. The newly proposed StableDRL framework stabilizes the update process by combining unconditional clipping to suppress extreme values with self-normalization tied to the effective information in the batch.

扩散语言模型（Diffusion Language Models, dLLMs） 在 强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL） 过程中会出现训练崩溃，因为其 log-likelihood 必须使用高方差的蒙特卡洛采样进行估计，这会产生带有噪声的重要性比率（importance ratios）。这些噪声比率会引发梯度尖峰，推动策略漂移形成正反馈循环，而条件裁剪（conditional clipping）等传统的自回归（AR）方法无法解决这一问题。新提出的 StableDRL 框架通过结合无条件裁剪（抑制极端值）和与批次有效信息挂钩的自归一化（self-normalization）来稳定更新过程。

👨‍💻 Engineering & Research

Run AI agents without exposing your infrastructure (Sponsor)

You wouldn't let an unknown human into your infrastructure. Why let an unknown agent? runs each agent in an isolated Firecracker VM with built-in identity — connected to your infrastructure and inference services with no secrets and no IAM wrestling. Zero standing privileges. Fully auditable. .

你不会让身份不明的人进入你的基础设施，为什么要让身份不明的智能体进入？ 它在独立的 Firecracker VM 中运行每个智能体，并内置身份认证——无需管理密钥，无需纠缠 IAM，即可连接到你的基础设施和推理服务。零常驻权限（Zero standing privileges）。完全可审计。 。

Parcae: Doing more with fewer parameters using stable looped models (6 minute read)

Parcae is one of the first stable architectures for looped language models. It achieves the quality of a Transformer twice the size with clean, predictable training. Parcae increases the recurrence rather than purely scaling data, creating a new medium to scale quality. The name Parcae is a homage to the three Roman fates: Nona, Decima, and Morta.

Parcae 是首批用于循环语言模型（looped language models）的稳定架构之一。它以清晰、可预测的训练方式达到了两倍于其规模的 Transformer 的质量。Parcae 通过增加循环次数而非单纯扩展数据量来扩展质量，创造了一种新的扩展媒介。Parcae 这个名字致敬了三位罗马命运女神：诺娜（Nona）、德琪玛（Decima） 和 莫尔塔（Morta）。

NVIDIA's Lyra 2 (32 minute read)

Lyra 2.0 is a framework for generating long, camera-controlled videos that maintain 3D consistency, using geometry-guided retrieval to prevent spatial forgetting and self-augmented training to reduce temporal drift.

NVIDIA 的 Lyra 2.0 是一个用于生成长时长、相机控制且保持 3D 一致性的视频的框架，它利用几何引导检索（geometry-guided retrieval）防止空间遗忘，并通过自增强训练（self-augmented training）减少时间漂移。

Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy in LLM Agents (1 minute read)

Researchers propose a Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy (ManyIH) to address instruction conflicts in LLM agents, surpassing traditional models with fixed privilege levels. They introduce ManyIH-Bench, assessing models across 12 privilege levels and 853 agent tasks, finding current models perform poorly at 40% accuracy. This highlights the need for scalable conflict resolution in complex agentic environments.

研究人员提出了一种 多层级指令层级结构（Many-Tier Instruction Hierarchy, ManyIH），以解决 LLM 智能体 中的指令冲突问题，超越了具有固定权限级别的传统模型。他们引入了 ManyIH-Bench 基准，在 12 个权限级别和 853 个智能体任务上评估模型，发现当前模型的准确率仅为 40%，表现不佳。这突显了在复杂的智能体环境中需要可扩展的冲突解决方案。

Jensen Huang – TPU competition, why we should sell chips to China, & Nvidia's supply chain moat (90 minute read)

This post features a transcript of an interview with Jensen Huang. He discusses TPU competition, Nvidia's lock on the supply chain needed to make advanced chips, whether the US should sell AI chips to China, why Nvidia isn't a hyperscaler, how the company makes its investments, and more. Links to audio and video of the interview are available.

这篇文章收录了对 Jensen Huang（黄仁勋） 的采访全文。他讨论了 TPU 竞争、Nvidia 对制造先进芯片所需供应链的垄断、美国是否应向中国出售 AI 芯片、Nvidia 为何不是超大规模云服务提供商（hyperscaler）、公司如何进行投资等话题。文章提供了采访的音频和视频链接。

Claude probably wasn't secretly nerfed. Anthropic made the black box too dark (10 minute read)

Users have accused Anthropic of nerfing Claude Code, but there's no evidence that Anthropic has done this. The strongest public reports still lack independent raw data. However, Anthropic didn't need to nerf Claude for Claude Code to become a different product. Effort defaults, adaptive thinking, cache duration, context compaction, quota policy, and status incidents can all change the experience while the model name stays the same.

用户指责 Anthropic 暗中削弱（nerf）了 Claude Code，但没有证据表明 Anthropic 这样做了。即使是最有力的公开报告也仍然缺乏独立的原始数据。然而，Anthropic 并不需要削弱 Claude，Claude Code 本身也可能变成一个不同的产品。努力默认值（effort defaults）、自适应思考、缓存时长、上下文压缩（context compaction）、配额策略和状态事件都可能在模型名称不变的情况下改变用户体验。

item.title: [翻译] Antirez: AI 网络安全不是工作量证明
item.description:
标签: #网络安全 #漏洞挖掘 #模型智能

摘要: 作者以OpenBSD SACK漏洞为例论证，AI驱动的网络安全并非“工作量证明”——发现复杂漏洞不取决于算力或采样次数的堆砌，而是受限于模型本身的智能水平；未来该领域的胜负手在于拥有更优质的模型并能更快调用它们。

原标题: AI cybersecurity is not proof of work

AI cybersecurity is not proof of work

The proof of work is the wrong analogy: finding hash collisions, while exponentially harder with N, is guaranteed to find, with enough work, some S so that H(S) satisfies N, so an asymmetry of resources used will see the side with more "work ability" eventually winning.

proof of work（工作量证明）是一个错误的类比：寻找 hash collisions（哈希碰撞）虽然随着 N 的增长呈指数级困难，但只要投入足够的计算量，就必然能找到某个 S 使得 H(S) 满足 N，因此资源使用的不对称性意味着拥有更多"work ability（工作能力）"的一方最终将获胜。

But bugs are different:
  1. Different LLMs executions take different branches, but eventually the possible branches based on the code possible states are saturated.
  2. If we imagine sampling the model for a bug in a given code M times, with M large, eventually the cap becomes not "M" (because of saturated state of the code AND the LLM sampler meaningful paths), but "I", the model intelligence level.
但漏洞（bugs）的情况不同：
  1. 不同的 LLMs（大语言模型）执行会走不同的分支，但最终基于代码可能状态的所有分支都会达到 saturated（饱和）。
  2. 如果我们想象对模型进行 M 次采样以寻找给定代码中的漏洞，当 M 足够大时，瓶颈最终不再是"M"（因为代码状态已达饱和，且 LLM 采样器的有意义路径也已穷尽），而是"I"，即 model intelligence level（模型智能水平）。
The OpenBSD SACK bug easily shows that: you can run an inferior model for an infinite number of tokens, and it will never realize(*) that the lack of validation of the start window, if put together with the integer overflow, then put together with the fact the branch where the node should never be NULL is entered regardless, will produce the bug.

OpenBSD SACK bug（OpenBSD SACK 漏洞）很好地说明了这一点：你可以用一个较差的模型运行无限多的 tokens（token），但它永远不会意识到（*），如果对起始窗口缺乏验证，再叠加 integer overflow（整数溢出），然后再叠加"无论何种情况都会进入节点本不应为 NULL 的分支"这一事实，就会产生该漏洞。

So, cyber security of tomorrow will not be like proof of work in the sense of "more GPU wins"; instead, better models, and faster access to such models, will win.

因此，未来的网络安全不会像 proof of work（工作量证明）那样意味着"更多 GPU 获胜"；相反，更好的模型以及更快获取这些模型的能力，才是制胜关键。

* Don't trust who says that weak models can find the OpenBSD SACK bug. I tried it myself. What happens is that weak models hallucinate (sometimes causally hitting a real problem) that there is a lack of validation of the start of the window (which is in theory harmless because of the start < end validation) and the integer overflow problem without understanding why they, if put together, create an issue. It's just pattern matching of bug classes on code that looks may have a problem, totally lacking the true ability to understand the issue and write an exploit. Test it yourself, GPT 120B OSS is cheap and available.

* 不要相信那些声称弱模型能发现 OpenBSD SACK bug（OpenBSD SACK 漏洞）的人。我自己试过。实际情况是，弱模型会产生 hallucinate（幻觉）（有时碰巧在因果上撞上一个真实问题），声称缺少对窗口起始位置的验证（这在理论上是无害的，因为有 start < end 的验证）以及存在整数溢出问题，但它并不理解为什么这两者结合起来就会引发问题。这只不过是对可能存在问题的代码进行漏洞类别的 pattern matching（模式匹配），完全缺乏真正理解问题并编写 exploit（漏洞利用程序）的能力。你自己可以测试，GPT 120B OSS 既便宜又容易获取。

BTW, this is why with this bug, the stronger the model you pick (but not enough to discover the true bug), the less likely it is it will claim there is a bug. Stronger models hallucinate less, so they can't see the problem in any side of the spectrum: the hallucination side of small models, and the real understanding side of Mythos.

顺便说一句，这就是为什么对于这个漏洞，你选择的模型越强（但还不足以发现真正的漏洞），它就越不可能声称存在漏洞。更强的模型产生 hallucinate（幻觉）更少，因此它们无法看到光谱中的任何问题：既看不到小模型的 hallucination（幻觉）一侧，也看不到 Mythos 真正理解的一侧。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: Datasette 1.0a27 发布
item.description:
标签: #Datasette #发布 #SQLite #API

摘要: Datasette 1.0a27 发布，核心变化包括以现代浏览器头部替代 Django 式 CSRF 防护，以及在 SQLite 事务中重命名表时新增 RenameTableEvent；同时还引入了 actor 参数、磁盘临时数据库选项和 upsert API 约束等多项改进。

原标题: datasette 1.0a27

Release: datasette 1.0a27

发布：datasette 1.0a27

Two major changes in this new Datasette alpha. I covered the first of thosein detail yesterday- Datasette no longer uses Django-style CSRF form tokens, instead using modern browser headersas described by Filippo Valsorda.

这个新的 Datasette alpha 版本有两项重大变更。我昨天详细介绍了第一项——Datasette 不再使用 Django 风格的 CSRF（跨站请求伪造）表单令牌，而是改用 Filippo Valsorda 所描述的现代化浏览器标头。

The second big change is that Datasette now fires a new RenameTableEvent any time a table is renamed during a SQLite transaction. This is useful because some plugins (like datasette-comments) attach additional data to table records by name, so a renamed table requires them to react in appropriate ways.

第二项重大变更是，Datasette 现在会在 SQLite 事务期间重命名表时触发一个新的 RenameTableEvent。这很有用，因为某些插件（如 datasette-comments）会按名称将额外数据附加到表记录上，因此重命名表需要它们做出相应的反应。

Here are the rest of the changes in the alpha:

以下是该 alpha 版本中的其余变更：

  • New actor= parameter for datasette.client methods, allowing internal requests to be made as a specific actor. This is particularly useful for writing automated tests. (#2688)
  • New Database(is_temp_disk=True) option, used internally for the internal database. This helps resolve intermittent database locked errors caused by the internal database being in-memory as opposed to on-disk. (#2683) (#2684)
  • The /<database>/<table>/-/upsert API (docs) now rejects rows with null primary key values. (#1936)
  • Improved example in the API explorer for the /-/upsert endpoint (docs). (#1936)
  • The /<database>.json endpoint now includes an "ok": true key, for consistency with other JSON API responses.
  • call_with_supported_arguments() is now documented as a supported public API. (#2678)
  • 为 datasette.client 方法新增了 actor= 参数，允许以特定 actor 身份发起内部请求。这对编写自动化测试特别有用。(#2688)
  • 新增了 Database(is_temp_disk=True) 选项，供内部数据库在内部使用。这有助于解决因内部数据库使用内存而非磁盘所导致的间歇性 database locked 错误。(#2683) (#2684)
  • /<database>/<table>/-/upsert API（文档）现在会拒绝主键值为 null 的行。(#1936)
  • 改进了 API 浏览器中 /-/upsert 端点（文档）的示例。(#1936)
  • /<database>.json 端点现在包含 "ok": true 键，以与其他 JSON API 响应保持一致。
  • call_with_supported_arguments() 现在已被文档化为受支持的公共 API。(#2678)
  • New actor= parameter for datasette.client methods, allowing internal requests to be made as a specific actor. This is particularly useful for writing automated tests. (#2688)
  • New Database(is_temp_disk=True) option, used internally for the internal database. This helps resolve intermittent database locked errors caused by the internal database being in-memory as opposed to on-disk. (#2683) (#2684)
  • The /<database>/<table>/-/upsert API (docs) now rejects rows with null primary key values. (#1936)
  • Improved example in the API explorer for the /-/upsert endpoint (docs). (#1936)
  • The /<database>.json endpoint now includes an "ok": true key, for consistency with other JSON API responses.
  • call_with_supported_arguments() is now documented as a supported public API. (#2678)
  • 为 datasette.client 方法新增了 actor= 参数，允许以特定 actor 身份发起内部请求。这对编写自动化测试特别有用。(#2688)
  • 新增了 Database(is_temp_disk=True) 选项，供内部数据库在内部使用。这有助于解决因内部数据库使用内存而非磁盘所导致的间歇性 database locked 错误。(#2683) (#2684)
  • /<database>/<table>/-/upsert API（文档）现在会拒绝主键值为 null 的行。(#1936)
  • 改进了 API 浏览器中 /-/upsert 端点（文档）的示例。(#1936)
  • /<database>.json 端点现在包含 "ok": true 键，以与其他 JSON API 响应保持一致。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: datasette.io 新闻预览工具
item.description:
标签: #Datasette #Claude #预览工具 #开发工具

摘要: 作者使用 Claude 为 datasette.io 的 YAML 新闻文件构建了一个自定义预览工具，可实时渲染页面效果并高亮 YAML 与 Markdown 错误，以简化内容编辑流程。

原标题: datasette.io news preview

datasette.io news preview

datasette.io 新闻预览

Tool:datasette.io news preview

工具：datasette.io 新闻预览

Thedatasette.iowebsite has a news section built from thisnews.yamlfile in the underlyingGitHubrepository. TheYAMLformat looks like this:
- date: 2026-04-15
  body: |-
    [Datasette 1.0a27](https://docs.datasette.io/en/latest/changelog.html#a27-2026-04-15) changes how CSRF protection works in a way that simplifies form and API integration, and introduces a new `RenameTableEvent` for when a table is renamed by a SQL query.
- date: 2026-03-18

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 我笔记本上的Qwen3.6画了只比Claude Opus 4.7更好的鹈鹕
item.description:
标签: #模型对比 #本地部署 #图像生成 #Qwen

摘要: 作者通过"鹈鹕骑自行车"这一趣味基准测试发现，本地运行在笔记本上的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B生成SVG插图的效果竟优于Anthropic最新的Claude Opus 4.7，这说明特定任务的图像生成质量与模型的整体实用性未必正相关。

原标题: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on my laptop drew me a better pelican than Claude Opus 4.7

Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on my laptop drew me a better pelican than Claude Opus 4.7

我笔记本上的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 给我画了一只比 Claude Opus 4.7 更好的鹈鹕

For anyone who has been (inadvisably) taking my pelican riding a bicycle benchmarks seriously as a robust way to test models, here are pelicans from this morning's two big model releases - Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from Alibaba and Claude Opus 4.7 from Anthropic.

对于那些（不明智地）一直把我的“pelican riding a bicycle benchmarks（鹈鹕骑自行车基准测试）”当作评估模型的可靠方式的人来说，以下是今早发布的两大模型所画的鹈鹕——来自 Alibaba（阿里巴巴）的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和来自 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 4.7。

Here's the Qwen 3.6 pelican, generated using this 20.9GB Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_S.gguf quantized model by Unsloth, running on my MacBook Pro M5 via LM Studio (and the llm-lmstudio plugin) - transcript here:

这是 Qwen 3.6 画的鹈鹕，使用 Unsloth 发布的这个 20.9GB 的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_S.gguf 量化模型生成，通过 LM Studio（以及 llm-lmstudio 插件）在我的 MacBook Pro M5 上本地运行——对话记录在此：

And here's one I got from Anthropic's brand new Claude Opus 4.7 (transcript):

这是我用 Anthropic 全新的 Claude Opus 4.7 得到的（对话记录）：

I'm giving this one to Qwen 3.6. Opus managed to mess up the bicycle frame!

这一轮我判给 Qwen 3.6。Opus 居然把自行车车架画错了！

I tried Opus a second time passing thinking_level: max. It didn't do much better (transcript):

我第二次尝试 Opus，传入了 thinking_level: max。结果也没好多少（对话记录）：

I don't think Qwen are cheating

我认为 Qwen 没有作弊

A lot of people are convinced that the labs train for my stupid benchmark. I don't think they do, but honestly this result did give me a little glint of suspicion. So I'm burning one of my secret backup tests - here's what I got from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Opus 4.7 for "Generate an SVG of a flamingo riding a unicycle":

很多人确信这些实验室针对我这个愚蠢的基准测试进行了训练。我不这么认为，但老实说，这个结果确实让我产生了一丝怀疑。所以我决定用掉一个秘密备用测试——以下是 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 和 Opus 4.7 在“生成一只火烈鸟骑独轮车的 SVG（可缩放矢量图形）”prompt 下的表现：

I'm giving this one to Qwen too, partly for the excellent <!-- Sunglasses on flamingo! --> SVG comment.

这一轮我也判给 Qwen，部分原因是那条精彩的 <!-- Sunglasses on flamingo! --> SVG 注释。

What can we learn from this?

我们能从中学到什么？

The pelican benchmark has always been meant as a joke - it's mainly a statement on how obtuse and absurd the task of comparing these models is.

鹈鹕基准测试一直都只是个玩笑——它主要是在表达，比较这些模型的任务是多么晦涩和荒谬。

The weird thing about that joke is that, for the most part, there has been a direct correlation between the quality of the pelicans produced and the general usefulness of the models. Those first pelicans from October 2024 were junk. The more recent entries have generally been much, much better - to the point that Gemini 3.1 Pro produces illustrations you could actually use somewhere, provided you had a pressing need to illustrate a pelican riding a bicycle.

这个玩笑的诡异之处在于，在很大程度上，生成鹈鹕的质量与模型的总体实用性之间存在直接相关性。2024 年 10 月那些最早的鹈鹕完全是垃圾。而最近的参赛作品总体上要好得多——以至于 Gemini 3.1 Pro 生成的插图已经真的可以在某些地方使用了，前提是你确实有紧急需求要为一幅“鹈鹕骑自行车”的插图配图。

Today, even that loose connection to utility has been broken. I have enormous respect for Qwen, but I very much doubt that a 21GB quantized version of their latest model is more powerful or useful than Anthropic's latest proprietary release.

如今，就连这种与实用性的松散联系也被打破了。我非常尊重 Qwen，但我严重怀疑他们最新模型的一个 21GB 量化版本会比 Anthropic 最新的专有发布版更强大或更有用。

If the thing you need is an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a bicycle though, right now Qwen3.6-35B-A3B running on a laptop is a better bet than Opus 4.7!

但如果你需要的正是一幅鹈鹕骑自行车的 SVG 插图，那么现在，在笔记本上运行的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 要比 Opus 4.7 更靠谱！

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: llm-anthropic 0.25 发布
item.description:
标签: #LLM #Claude #版本发布

摘要: llm-anthropic 0.25 正式发布，新增了对 claude-opus-4.7 模型的支持（包含 thinking_effort:xhigh 配置）以及 thinking_display 和 thinking_adaptive 选项，同时将默认 max_tokens 提升至各模型上限，并移除了对旧版结构化输出 beta 头信息的依赖。

原标题: llm-anthropic 0.25

Release: llm-anthropic 0.25

llm-anthropic 0.25 版本发布

New model: claude-opus-4.7, which supports thinking_effort: xhigh. #66
New thinking_display and thinking_adaptive boolean options. thinking_display summarized output is currently only available in JSON output or JSON logs.
Increased default max_tokens to the maximum allowed for each model.
No longer uses obsolete structured-outputs-2025-11-13 beta header for older models.

新增模型 claude-opus-4.7，支持 thinking_effort（思考努力度）参数设置为 xhigh。#66
新增 thinking_display（思考展示）和 thinking_adaptive（自适应思考）布尔选项。thinking_display 的摘要输出目前仅在 JSON 输出或 JSON 日志中可用。
将默认的 max_tokens（最大令牌数）提升至各模型允许的上限。
不再为旧模型使用过时的 structured-outputs-2025-11-13 beta 标头。
